name: Nahi's Winter Holidate
source:
Step into the shoes of Nahi Kikomori, a shut-in vampire girl who is content to spend the holiday season in hibernation. That is, until she receives a message with an invitation to a local tree-lighting event. Who will she choose to spend this romantic evening with?

[From [url=https://nahikikomori.itch.io/nahis-winter-holidate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
化身为足不出户的吸血鬼女孩Nahi Kikomori，她原本很乐意靠冬眠过完整个假期。直到一条消息传来，有人邀请她参加当地的圣诞树亮灯仪式。她会选谁共度这个浪漫的夜晚呢？

［摘自[url=https://nahikikomori.itch.io/nahis-winter-holidate]Itch.io[/url]］
